{{small|([[Chief executive officer|CEO]])}} | products = | revenue = {{increase}} [[US$]]2 billion {{small|(2022)}}{{cite web |title=Kiwoom Securities - Company Overview & Statistics |url=https://www.forbes.com/companies/kiwoom-securities/ |website=Forbes |access-date=July 6, 2023}} | aum = {{increase}} US$38.1 billion {{small|(2022)}} | owner = | num_employees = 941 | num_employees_year = 2022 | parent = [[Daou Technology Inc.]] | website = {{URL|kiwoom.com}} }} '''Kiwoom Securities''' is a South Korean [[financial services]] company based in [[Seoul]]. Founded in 2000, the company managed US$38.1 billion in assets in 2022 and was ranked on the [[Forbes Global 2000|''Forbes'' Global 2000]] list. Kiwoom acts as a [[broker]] for both foreign and domestic [[stock exchange]]s and [[futures exchange]]s. The company additionally provides other financial services, such as investment, [[risk management]], [[asset management]], and [[investment strategy]] research.{{cite web |title=Kiwoom Securities Co, Ltd. - Company Profile & Facts |url=https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/039490.KS/profile/ |website=[[Yahoo! Finance]] |access-date=July 6, 2023}} ==History== Kiwoom Securities was founded on January 31, 2000, in [[Seoul]]. On March 15, 2001, Bong-soo Kim, one of the company's founders and the eventual chairman of the [[Korea Exchange]], was appointed as [[chief executive officer]] and president. On April 23, 2004, Kiwoom become a [[public company]] and posted its [[initial public offering]] on the [[KOSDAQ]] market.{{cite web |title=History |url=https://www.kiwoom.com/h/ir/engintroduce/VEngHistory1View |website=Kiwoom Securities |access-date=July 6, 2023}} In November 2018, Kiwoom signed a five-year, [[South Korean won|₩]]10 billion (US$9.5 million) contract to acquire the naming rights for the [[KBO League]]'s Seoul-based Heroes baseball team, officially renaming it as the [[Kiwoom Heroes]] for the 2019 season.{{cite news |last1=Yoo |first1=Hee-jo |title=Baseball club unveils new uniform, logo under new sponsorship |url=https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20190115004200315 |access-date=July 6, 2023 |work=[[Yonhap News Agency]] |date=January 15, 2019}} In May 2023, the [[Financial Supervisory Service (South Korea)|Financial Supervisory Service]] began an investigation of Kiwoom for alleged acts of [[stock manipulation]]. News of the investigation caused Kiwoom's stock price to fall.{{cite news |last1=Lee |first1=Min-hyung |title=FSS to investigate Kiwoom Securities for stock manipulation |url=https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/www/biz/2023/05/126_350328.html |access-date=July 6, 2023 |work=[[The Korea Times]] |date=May 4, 2023}} ==References== {{reflist}} {{KOSPI 200|state=collapsed}} [[Category:South Korean companies established in 2000]] [[Category:Companies based in Seoul]] [[Category:Financial services companies established in 2000]] [[Category:Financial services companies of South Korea]] [[Category:Online brokerages]] [[Category:Companies in the KOSPI 200]]
